dedupe_keys.name: lorawan network server simulator for downlink scheduling

description: This Python simulator evaluates downlink scheduling strategies of a LoRaWAN network server, released on Zenodo in September 2026 as a beta version by Carlos Fernández. It models end devices, gateways, channels, uplink traffic, downlink scheduling, duty-cycle restrictions, collisions, half-duplex losses, packet delivery and energy statistics, so that different scheduling policies can be compared on the same scenario. Coverage: generic synthetic LoRaWAN deployments. Format and access: Python source on Zenodo and GitHub, free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: an early beta by a single author; not validated against field deployments. Simulation uses: capacity planning of low-power wide-area networks for sensors in utilities and cities, including load on gateways and the reliability of downlink commands. Related records: LoRaEnergySim simulates LoRa node energy use, and ns-3 hosts LoRaWAN modules.
